name: explain_answer
description: Explain the answer of a computed answer - a checked write-up as the answer (its first sentence the summary), else the narrative computed from the result; a stats result told directly; the gaps.

history.why: Query view: the answer part told high level first, details folded and formatted
Consolidation: shared rules now live in query_explain; keep only what is specific to the answer part.
Restore the code, checks and agent of the current version: approving the consolidation proposal (made before the trace validators) had put back the older code. The consolidated SKILL.md stays.
answer the question directly: a verdict from known quality measures (how many reach the level, said in the text), each measure's median and range, then each item's own values best first; no model

The user found the chat reply (direct answer, spread, coverage, method, caveats) better than the Query view's answer, which led with a template narrative and folded the agent's write-up into the details. A write-up the synthesis check passed now leads, with its [S n] citations to the data; the computed narrative moves to the details. A stats step (mean over every entity) is told as the mean over how many, the median and range.
